steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, what am I looking at...?
In the void, a huge mural was silently suspended in mid-air, like a creation of the gods.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is the distribution center for Hypercubes, a place where wishes are born and granted, and also a breeding ground for vice and temptation.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The gacha interface. You and EMP's lot only play offline games, so I guess you haven't seen this before.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Here you can spend Hypercubes to obtain the most powerful S-Class Sinners.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: O-kay...? But isn't that pretty cool? All you need to do is spend some Hypercubes and you get powerful Sinners.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's not that easy. Luck rules this place. Some people get exactly what they want with just one tap, using a free Warrant they earned as a reward.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: While others still have their hands empty after eighty pulls.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Well, when it comes to luck... I guess... everyone has their unlucky moments, right?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: By the way, Hella, you're just a B-Class Sinner in Project: Dark. People sometimes get nine copies of you in ten pulls.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! Hecate, let's smash these stupid buttons to pieces!
